items.html: But the light of the seven lower ones, (43) which took only from the Guf downward, that is, from the end of the Shibolet of the beard downward, as above — therefore they too have no vapours to shine to them. Rather, they are alluded to in the secret of “and the arms of his hands were made supple,” which is the secret of the ten drops that were cast from between the nails, as mentioned in Tikkun 69, as is known; for they themselves are the discernment of the kings. For the annulment of the kings came about because man, male and female, was not yet corrected as one.
